title: Integrations
workitemDescription: Configure external work item credentials and managed projects. Aone is currently supported.
channelsDescription: Connect Agents to messaging channels so group members can @mention an Agent to chat.
channelsFailed: Failed to load collaboration channels. Refresh and try again.
unavailableChannel: This channel is not available yet
selectProjectFirst: Select at least one managed project first
firstImportHelp: Configure platform credentials and managed projects before the first import. The external platform is the source of truth for requirements, defects, tasks, comments and statuses. Local comments are written back with a platform signature.
requiredProjects: Select at least one managed project
projectPlaceholder: Search first, then select managed projects
issueIdsHint: Enter external work item IDs separated by commas; leave blank to sync all work items in managed projects
outboxCommand: Process the work item writeback queue
agentPlaceholder: Select an Agent in this tenant
defaultPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the default
dingCallback: Callback URL (copy to the DingTalk bot console)
dingDescription: Bind a DingTalk bot to an Agent. Group members can @mention the bot to have multi-turn conversations with the Agent.
dingEmpty: No bindings yet. Select “New binding” to connect your first DingTalk bot.
feishuSaved: Feishu binding saved. Configure the callback URL and publish the Feishu app.
feishuDescription: Receives messages through HTTP callbacks. Supports text in direct chats and multi-turn conversations when @mentioned in groups, with text replies. Enable the bot in the Feishu Open Platform and configure an online Executor for the Agent first.
feishuDeleteHelp: This app will stop receiving and replying to messages.
validAppId: Enter a valid App ID starting with cli_
keepSecret: Leave blank to keep the existing secret
keepToken: Leave blank to keep the existing Token
tokenHelp: Find this under “Events & callbacks → Encryption strategy” in the Feishu app
keepEncryption: Encryption is configured; leave blank to keep the existing key
encryptionHelp: Optional. Match the Feishu encryption strategy; when configured, signatures are verified and events decrypted.
clearEncryption: Clear Encrypt Key (also disable encryption in Feishu)
feishuCallback: Callback URL (copy to Feishu event subscriptions)
feishuSetup: After saving, select “Send events to developer server” in Feishu, enter the public HTTPS callback URL and subscribe to “Receive message im.message.receive_v1”. Enable permissions to read direct messages sent to the bot, receive group messages that @mention the bot and send messages as the app. Publish the app and add the bot to the group.
